description:
Get a list of the customSecurityAttributeDefinition objects and their properties.

TIP: Lists custom security attribute definitions. Each has attributeSet, name, type (String, Integer, Boolean), isSearchable, isCollection, usePreDefinedValuesOnly, status (Available, Deprecated), and description. Custom security attributes provide flexible tagging for Entra objects.
